# Cancellation settles before a 3600-second backoff, without waiting for due time.
server start
retry-task task.json once 3600
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-cancel
job-id JOB
await-state $JOB retrying
history failed
skygo jobs cancel $JOB --yes
await-state $JOB canceled
history failed
exists first
! exists second
server stop
server start
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_CANCELED"'
history failed
! exists second
server stop
! stderr .
